_comment: ISO 3166-2 codes in regions.yaml that Natural Earth 5.1.2 records under another code, mapped to the Natural Earth unit or units whose outline stands in for them. `basis` says how each mapping was made. A code mapped to null falls back to its country.

FR-HDF.basis: Natural Earth's own region field names these five departments Hauts-de-France.

IN-TS.basis: The same state, Telangana, under its earlier code.

KZ-23.basis: The same region, Atyrau, under its earlier code.

KZ-43.basis: The same region, Kyzylorda (Qyzylorda), under its earlier code.

KZ-61.basis: Turkistan Region is South Kazakhstan Region renamed in 2018, less Shymkent city (Wikipedia, Turkistan Region).

TZ-31.basis: Songwe Region was created in 2016 from the western half of Mbeya Region (Wikipedia, Songwe Region).

CZ-205.basis: ISO 3166-2 code hierarchy: districts CZ-20x lie in the Central Bohemian Region (Středočeský).

MA-AZI.basis: Azilal province lay in the former Tadla-Azilal region.

MA-BOM.basis: Boulemane province lay in the former Fès-Boulemane region.

MA-ERR.basis: Errachidia province lay in the former Meknès-Tafilalet region (Wikipedia, Meknès-Tafilalet).

MA-KHO.basis: Khouribga province lay in the former Chaouia-Ouardigha region (Wikipedia, Chaouia-Ouardigha).

MA-OUA.basis: Ouarzazate province lay in the former Souss-Massa-Draâ region (Wikipedia, Souss-Massa-Draâ).

MW-KR.basis: Natural Earth 5.1.2 has no unit for Karonga District.
